parameters.name: coating_hull_roughness
parameters.justification: AHR of the hard coat; upper bound widened so the conventional 125 um baseline lies inside

parameters.name: equivalent_laminar_gap
parameters.justification: H = nu*U/u_tau^2 at 7.7 m/s with u_tau = 0.21 m/s (tau_w about 45 Pa, CF = 1.48e-3)

parameters.name: smooth_threshold_roughness
parameters.justification: AHR below which Townsin's correlation gives no added resistance at this Re

parameters.name: roughness_offset_coefficient
parameters.justification: Calibrated so that AHR 125 um gives the Townsin added friction dCF/CF = +6.5 % at Re = 1.3e9 (negative slip = downward shift of the log law)
